title: Distribution of Four-Square Representations Among Orderings

problemStatement.formal: For n = a₁² + a₂² + a₃² + a₄² with 0 ≤ a₁ ≤ a₂ ≤ a₃ ≤ a₄, classify representation types by their symmetry groups and compute contribution = signFactor × permutations.
problemStatement.plain: Classify four-square representations by their symmetry type (trivial, all-equal, three-equal, two-pair, two-equal, all-distinct) and compute how many ordered representations each unordered type produces.

Provides computable framework for analyzing r₄(n) structure
